about: Gold multi-label emotion data for Tidder's detector (lib/feel.js). Labels are the states a reasonable reader would take the TEXT to show — not a declared state, since the declared one is user input. Single annotator (project owner), written 2026-10; inter-annotator agreement has not been measured, which is itself a documented limit.
